changelog: - **The Focus view and neighbour keys act only on the canvas.** `f` (Focus view) and `[` / `]` (select the previous or next connected node) also worked while you were using the left panel, the timeline or the status bar, so a key pressed there could change the canvas behind it. Now they work only while the canvas has the keyboard — after you click the canvas or one of its nodes, or before you have used any other control.
